kb.title: Descaling a copper kettle
kb.body: Descale once a month in hard water areas: fill the kettle half way with water, add two tablespoons of citric acid, boil, leave it for 30 minutes, then empty it and rinse twice with fresh boiled water. Never use vinegar on copper.

kb.title: Caring for a cast iron teapot
kb.body: Rinse with hot water only and dry over a low flame. No soap, no dishwasher.

kb.title: Storing loose leaf tea
kb.body: Keep tea in an airtight tin away from light, heat and strong smells.
